Name: OUTDATED The Little Things - Haley
Author: GoldfishMassacre
Description:
[b]This mod is horribly outdated, install at your own risk.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20642]New version here![/url][/b]

After marrying Haley(whom I love with my all my heart) the muddy portrait that occasionally showed up when she talked about cleaning kept throwing me off and I couldn't stand it anymore, so I decided to edit her portraits a bit.

Nothing major really! The biggest edits are her dress, smiling portrait and of course, the muddy portraits. I'm very pleased with the results so I thought I'd share it here. :)

[size=3]Installation:[/size][size=1]
If you're paranoid, backup your save file and the original file before installing![/size]

Go into your SteamLibrary, find the Stardew Valley folder > Content > Portraits.
Then drag in the XNB file and check "yes" to overwrite the existing one.

Easy peasy! Enjoy!

[size=3]P.S If you'd like me to edit some other characters portraits, let me know! :)[/size]

/GM
